svg.text: An HSM state hosting a BTree / blueprint — declare, provision, supply, tick, cancel
Green = the mechanism already exists and is reused. Amber = must be built. Red = still an open design question.
1 · AUTHORING — what makes a state a HOST
public Guid SubtreeAssetId; // already in HsmStateDto
A state is a subtree host iff SubtreeAssetId != Guid.Empty.
The carrier exists today. Extend what it may name: BTree · nested HSM · blueprint Instance.
+ the binding record — same shape as a blueprint assignment
{ AssetId, JsonParams, ResolverName? }
WHY THIS SHAPE — it is the assignment record, authored instead of evented
A behaviour is supplied by an EVENT:
AssignBehaviorEvent { BehaviorName, JsonParams }
A hosted subtree is supplied by its PARENT ASSET:
state.Subtree { AssetId, JsonParams, ResolverName? }
⇒ same three fields, one supply pipeline, two carriers.
Static binding, like a call's arguments — not a runtime message.
2 · AT BEHAVIOUR ACTIVATION — provision every hosted slot up front (BTree's precedent)
BehaviorIngressSystem already calls
ProvisionStatefulSlots(repo, entity, def.StatefulWorkingSlots)
right after commit.
Each hosting state contributes one slot:
[ Cursor 16 | Params N | State M ]
Allocate at activation, never mid-tick — the same rule BTree already follows for its stateful nodes.
3 · AT STATE ENTRY — reset, then resolve
1. reset the child
zero its state; Cursor.ResumeAt = 0
2. run the resolver ONCE, into the child's own slot
ParseParams(json, slotPayload + paramsOffset, world, self)
⭐ The delegate already takes a destination pointer — the pipeline is reused unchanged,
only the pointer differs. Behaviours pass &bb.BehaviorParameters[0]; a child passes its slot.
4 · EACH TICK — Activity-shaped re-entry
ProcessActivityPhase already runs every active leaf
and its ancestor chain, every tick.
⇒ the child resumes from its own cursor / __phase.
No status return is needed — and none is possible:
ExecuteAction returns void, and the phases are stages
of ONE tick (Idle → Entry → RTC → Activity → Idle).
5 · AT STATE EXIT — cancel
Bump the slot's InstanceVersion ⇒ a suspended cursor
is stale and refuses to resume. The mechanism ships.
Ruling: exit IS an external cancellation. A hosted child does NOT block the transition.
COMPLETION — the child raises an event
A finished subtree writes through the HsmCommandWriter
every action already receives; a transition listens.
Idiomatic HSM: a state does not "finish", it transitions on an event. Nothing new.
⛔ STILL OPEN — parameters WIRED FROM THE PARENT'S LIVE VARIABLES, not authored constants.
BTree solves this with a per-node ExpressionTargetField. HSM has no equivalent — that is exactly W11 / E7,
arriving from another direction. Authored-constant params work with everything above; wired params do not yet.
